caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware crock with a slightly flared rim, two small rounded handles on either side, and an open top with a dark interior. The exterior surface of the crock is light tan or beige, and it features blue painted decorations. On the front, there is an illustration of a horse facing right, tethered to a post by a rope extending from its bridle. Above the horse is the number "4" painted in blue, suggesting the container's capacity. Flanking the number and horse are two blue stylized leafy or fern-like motifs, one on each side. The crock is set against a plain, light neutral background.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
